subject: NimbusAI evaluation MAP: provisioning checkpoints and final close cadence
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NimbusAI evaluation MAP: provisioning checkpoints and final close cadence

Alex —

Following our call, attaching the initial MAP worksheet (Nimbus-MAP-v1.xlsx) and a short checklist for the environment handoff. This thread will track the provisioning tasks we need to complete before the trial close and the evaluation cutover. High-level asks for Redwood to support POC readiness: 

1) Org and API keys: we will provision a dedicated Redwood org for NimbusAI; you (ops@nimbus.ai) will need two API keys (staging + eval) with token TTL of 12 hours. We can issue keys once the org ID is confirmed.

2) IP allowlist: please provide the CIDR ranges you want to allow. We can accept per-IP or VPC peering — see VPC note below.

3) VPC peering: recommend peering for consistent low-latency access. If you prefer peering, send a proposed CIDR block (vpc-peering-cidr.txt) and a preferred peer window.

4) KMS / secrets: if you require customer-managed keys, flag that now so we can route procurement and security checks.

5) Timeline and gates: our proposed close cadence is: 
  - Week 0 (this week): org ID, primary contact, and CIDR list
  - Week 1: API keys issued, peering request initiated, sample traffic test
  - Week 2: evaluation run (3 days), quality/latency checkpoint, decision meeting

Can you confirm the CIDRs and whether NimbusAI will accept peering? Also flag any procurement or legal blockers — Marissa will help shepherd PO/contract items.

Attachments: Nimbus-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP worksheet), vpc-peering-cidr.txt (sample CIDRs), po-request.pdf (PO template).

Thanks — looking to lock the org ID today so Sean can start the peering prep.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0122

From: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@nimbus.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@nimbus.ai
Date: Sun, 1 Jun 2025 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NimbusAI evaluation MAP: provisioning checkpoints and final close cadence

Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear plan and the MAP. We're aligned on the timeline in principle. Quick answers: 

- We will accept VPC peering (preferred). I'll have our network engineer send the requested CIDR ranges by EOD.
- For API keys, we want the staging key first; evaluation key after peering completes. Staging key should be scoped to read-only generation for the first 48 hours.
- We are evaluating using our own KMS for secrets; ops team will confirm whether that will be ready within the two-week window.

Two asks from us: 
1) Can Redwood confirm the exact ports and protocols your runtime needs for peering (we need this for firewall rules)?
2) For the evaluation run, do you have a suggested sample prompt set and traffic shape? If you can pre-load a small prompt set it will speed validation.

I'll send the CIDR file and contact details for our infra lead (cc'd ops@nimbus.ai). If KMS timing slips, we may fall back to Redwood-managed secrets for the evaluation period.

Best,
Alex Ruiz
Head of Product
NimbusAI
alex.ruiz@nimbus.ai
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NimbusAI evaluation MAP: provisioning checkpoints and final close cadence

Alex —

Thanks — we can support the flow you described. Quick technical notes that ops asked me to confirm: 

- Ports/protocols: outbound TLS (443) for runtime telemetry and model fetch; optional inbound for health checks if you want a reverse probe (we can do health checks via the peered VPC). No special ports beyond 443 for normal traffic. If you plan to use private KMS endpoints, we will need those hostnames/IPs whitelisted.

- Peering details: Redwood's peering accepts a /16 or smaller. We attached vpc-peering-cidr.txt with our suggested example and the peering process link. Peering handshake typically completes within 24–48 hours once both sides accept. 

- API keys: Vanessa can issue a staging key scoped down to generation/read-only. Once peering shows OK we will promote/issue the eval key. Keys are issued via the Redwood Console and will be logged in the MAP worksheet.

- Prompt set: Marissa, can you drop the sample prompt pack (we recommend 50–100 prompts representing burst and steady traffic) into the Drive link Vanessa included? We'll run both latency and quality sweeps during the 3-day evaluation window.

Attachments: vpc-peering-cidr.txt (example CIDRs)

I'll open a short runbook ticket for the peering handshake and tag Nimbus ops so we have the window tracked.

— Sean Gallagher
Solutions Engineering Lead
Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
From: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@nimbus.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@nimbus.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Jun 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NimbusAI evaluation MAP: provisioning checkpoints and final close cadence

Vanessa / Sean —

All good on our side. Ops just confirmed the CIDR block and will post the formal peering request this afternoon. We will accept the staging key policy you suggested; ops will share the prompt pack by EOD so you can pre-load.

If peering completes by Thursday we can run the evaluation on Friday-Sunday and meet Monday for the decision checkpoint. I'll also attach the signed PO request to this thread once procurement routes it.

Thanks for moving quickly — appreciate the clear MAP.

— Alex

On Tue, Jun 3, 2025 at 10:05 AM Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com> wrote:

>
